project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase + Tailwind CSS
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files or test scripts in package.json)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm packages available. Node v20.20.2 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin. No npx, use full path or add to PATH.
contribution_requirements: Code in English, UI in French. 'use client' components with Supabase browser client (createClient from @/lib/supabase/client). Lucide React icons. Tailwind classes. No heavy external dependencies.
key_patterns: CRUD pages follow the sector pattern: inline form + table, useState for state, useEffect for fetching, createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client. Settings cards use Link + card className + icon + title + description. Export Excel via HTML table saved as .xls (see reports/[id]/page.tsx). All pages are 'use client' components.
directory_structure: src/app/ = pages (App Router), src/components/ = shared components, src/lib/ = utilities, src/data/ = static data files, supabase/migrations/ = SQL migrations, docs/ = documentation
